subject: Deployment preferences & connectivity matrix — follow-up
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Gupta <alex.gupta@netsellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment preferences & connectivity matrix — follow-up

Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our side after the discovery call:  

1) Summary of preference: you indicated Netsell's preference leans toward a private deployment for PHI workloads (customer-managed VPC + PrivateLink) to minimize egress and simplify network zoning. You also asked for comparisons to Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput.  

2) Action items we committed to:  
- Share a short connectivity matrix that maps Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC to networking responsibilities and typical anchor items (egress IPs, peering vs PrivateLink, TLS termination). Attachment: redwood_connectivity_matrix_v1.xlsx  
- Confirm the list of egress IPs (or range) you'll need to allow and any firewall/proxy hops on your side.  
- Provide suggested maintenance windows for initial onboarding and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP). Attachment: mutual_action_plan_RWIN-2026-1372.pdf  

3) Questions for you (short):  
- Do you have a strong preference between PrivateLink vs VPC Peering for the initial rollout? If PrivateLink, will you manage an endpoint in your account or do you want Redwood to provide the endpoint service?  
- Any internal compliance/reqs we should be aware of for audit logs retention or KMS key separation?  

Next step: Marissa (cc'd) will follow up with the connectivity matrix and proposed MAP by EOD Tue. Can you share the egress IPs and preferred maintenance window for the first-week test cutover?  

Thanks,

Elliot Price
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_connectivity_matrix_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 54KB)]

From: Alex Gupta <alex.gupta@netsellhealth.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Netsell Health - Infra Team <infra-team@netsellhealth.com>, procurement@netsellhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment preferences & connectivity matrix — follow-up

Elliot — thanks for the clear recap. A few items from our side after the call:  

1) High-level decision: We are leaning towards PrivateLink (SaaS endpoint) for the initial POC because it avoids exposing peered routing across our VPCs and aligns with our security team’s preference. We may evaluate VPC Peering later for lower-latency on-prem integrations.  

2) Egress/IPs: For allowlisting we can accept a small set of stable egress IPs. Can you confirm whether Redwood will provide static egress IPs per-tenant in PrivateLink mode? If not, we will need a CIDR range for firewall rules. For planning, here are the internal firewall hops and the existing proxy we run:  
- Primary proxy cluster: proxy-us-east-1.netsell.internal (10.24.3.0/24)
- Perimeter firewall ACL managed by Security Ops (we can add IPs once you provide them)

3) TLS & termination: We will terminate TLS at our proxy; we do require mTLS between our proxy and Redwood for the control plane calls. Do you support mTLS for PrivateLink endpoints?  

4) Compliance: SOC2 maturity is fine; our security team needs to confirm KMS separation for customer-managed keys. Are you able to support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for Private deployments?  

5) Maintenance window: Prefer weekends, Sat 02:00–06:00 UTC for any cutover testing.  

Attaching our simple network diagram for reference.  

Alex Gupta
Head of Infrastructure
Netsell Health
[Attachment: netsell_network_overview_v2.png (image/png, 220KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Gupta <alex.gupta@netsellhealth.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment preferences & connectivity matrix — follow-up

Alex — great notes, thanks. Quick answers inline and an ask for a couple of items we need to finalize scoping:  

> From: Alex Gupta
> We are leaning towards PrivateLink (SaaS endpoint) for the initial POC because it avoids exposing peered routing…

- PrivateLink vs Peering: for Netsell's use case (PHI + multiple internal VPCs) PrivateLink is the common recommendation — smaller blast radius, easier to manage access lists, and avoids cross-account route propagation. We'll include the tradeoffs in the matrix we attached earlier.  

> Can you confirm whether Redwood will provide static egress IPs per-tenant in PrivateLink mode?

- Egress IPs: In PrivateLink mode, Redwood can provide a small, realistically stable set of outbound egress IPs for tenancy slices. We will confirm the exact /32 list in the next update (target Tue EOD). If you prefer to allow by prefix we can provide a /27 as a fallback.  

> Do you support mTLS for PrivateLink endpoints?

- mTLS: Yes, we support mTLS for control-plane and data-plane calls in Private deployments. We'll include configuration notes and cert expectations in the MAP.  

> KMS / BYOK:

- Customer-managed keys: Supported in Private deployments (we integrate with common KMS providers). We'll need the KMS ARN and requested rotation policy to document in the onboarding runbook.  

Requested items to finalize scope:  
- Confirm whether Netsell will provision the VPC endpoint (recommended) or wants Redwood to create the endpoint service (we can do either, but provisioning in your account accelerates cutover).  
- Share the firewall admin contact and CIDR(s) for the proxy cluster (you already listed 10.24.3.0/24 — can you confirm it's the final list?).  

I'll pull the egress IP set and an annotated mapping of responsibilities into the MAP and re-send by Tue 20 Oct. Once you confirm the endpoint provisioning choice we can schedule a 60-min onboarding call during your preferred maintenance window (Sat 02:00–06:00 UTC).  

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_connectivity_matrix_v1.xlsx (updated, 58KB)]

- We will provision the VPC endpoint in our account (preferred).
- Proxy CIDR confirmed: 10.24.3.0/24 (no additional ranges for the POC).
- KMS ARN will be provided by our compliance team separately (target EOD Tue).

Please proceed with the MAP and include the static egress /32s if possible. Once we have the MAP we can route this to procurement for a quick review of terms. Proposed onboarding slot: Sat 24 Oct 2026, 02:00–03:30 UTC.  

Appreciate the speed here — looking forward to the MAP and the egress list.

—Alex
